preconditions: sub_53CBC0 requires a non-null, non-empty filename argument a2; a null or empty filename returns 0 immediately.
String registry registration (sub_53C800) proceeds only while the entry count dword_8B8E30 is below 32 and the input string is non-empty.
sub_53C900 lookup requires a non-empty input string; an empty input returns the input pointer unchanged without searching.

The 256-byte SrcStr stack buffers in sub_53C800, sub_53C900 and sub_53CBC0 bound the strings copied from the caller; inputs exceeding the buffer would overrun it (unverified, no bounds guard observed).
postconditions: On successful MAS load, sub_53CBC0 appends the cube-map object to the singly linked list rooted at dword_8B8F14 (next at offset 0x130, back-pointer at 0x12C) and increments the object count dword_8B6AC0.
On MAS open failure, sub_53CBC0 reports an 'Error opening MAS file' message through sub_53C590 and returns -2.

sub_53C900 sets the 0x400 flag on the matched registry entry dword_8B5A38[33 * index]; sub_53CA00 subsequently prunes entries carrying the 0x400 flag and compacts the survivors to the front of the table.
sub_53C9C0 rewrites each flag dword that has bit 0x4000 set, clearing 0x4000 and setting 0x400.
sub_4FC550, when sub_53CBC0 reports success (zero return), writes the wcclouds/wccloudr cloud texture variant handles into this+0x50 and this+0x84 and frees the heap path buffer.
side_effects: sub_53C800 mutates the global string registry: writes the normalized input into byte_8B5A3C slot 0, shifts existing 132-byte entries up one slot via sub_53C6B0, and increments dword_8B8E30.
sub_53C900 sets flag bit 0x400 on dword_8B5A38[33 * index] for a matched registry entry.
sub_53CA00 compacts the global entry table: prunes 0x400-flagged entries, zeroes trailing slots up to the boundary dword_8B6AB8, and stores the surviving count into dword_8B8E30.
sub_53C590 copies a null-terminated source string into the global scratch buffer byte_8B6AC8, including the terminator.
sub_53C6B0 materializes a two-part record (leading dword at this+0x00 plus a byte string from this+0x04) into its destination; a null source zeroes both.
sub_53CBC0 reads a 12-byte MAS header, allocates and frees a 308-byte cube-map object, and appends successful loads to the dword_8B8F14 list.
sub_4FC550 allocates and frees a 256-byte heap path buffer and writes cloud texture variant fields at this+0x50 and this+0x84.
unresolved: Cut-edge dependency 0x004FC2F0 (CloudSceneObjectRandomSelector) called by sub_4FC550 is outside this packet; the random cloud-object selection semantics and the meaning of flag a2 are not evidenced here.
Cut-edge dependency 0x004FC400 (cloud texture variant registration) is outside this packet; the exact format of the wcclouds/wccloudr variants written at this+0x50 and this+0x84 is unknown.

Cut-edge dependency 0x0053C6A0 (TwoFieldInitializer) used by sub_53CA00 to seed its 32-entry staging table is outside this packet; the two-field record layout is inferred only from the copy twin sub_53C6B0.
Cut-edge dependency 0x0053CE40 (PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval) is outside this packet; whether the loaded MAS resource participates in a physics-object linked list is not evidenced here.
Cut-edge dependency 0x005665B0 (path component joiner) used by sub_4FC550 to append the track/common/logomap.mas components is outside this packet.
Cut-edge dependency 0x00566650 (StringCopyWithBufferRealloc) used by sub_4FC550 to seed the path buffer is outside this packet.
sub_589901 normalization behavior (uppercase/lowercase/trim) is not evidenced; it is applied by sub_53C800, sub_53C900 and sub_53CBC0 before comparisons.
The a1 argument of sub_53C590 is unused in its body; the reporting channel of the string copied into byte_8B6AC8 is unknown.
Meaning of the 0x400 and 0x4000 flag bits on dword_8B5A38 entries is unknown; only the writes are evidenced.
The exact 132-byte registry record layout is inferred arithmetically (33 dwords at dword_8B5A38 vs 132-byte slots at byte_8B5A3C); the real record structure is unverified.

Branch polarity of sub_53CBC0 from the caller side: sub_4FC550 runs its cloud-setup body when sub_53CBC0 returns zero, but the -1/-2 error codes confirm only that nonzero means failure, not the full error contract.
Thread requirement (game_thread) is inferred from the setup-path callers (pit-crew load, SpecialFX_Init, VidMan_Init) rather than observed.
Global 0x008AFE64 is listed as a read global for sub_4FC550 by packet facts but never appears in its raw body; it is likely touched by a callee (StringCopyWithBufferRealloc or sub_5665B0).
tests_required: Write a distinctive filename through sub_53CBC0 and verify the open retry walks the registered path-prefix array (dword_8B8E30 entries, 132-byte stride at byte_8B5A3C).
Register the same string twice via sub_53C800 and verify the second call returns 0 without changing dword_8B8E30.
Set flag 0x400 on an entry via sub_53C900, then run sub_53CA00 and verify the entry is pruned, survivors are compacted, and dword_8B8E30 reflects the surviving count.
Verify sub_53C9C0 rewrites a 0x4000-flagged entry to clear 0x4000 and set 0x400 across the dword_8B5A38 array.
Load a Cubemas410-header MAS through sub_53CBC0 and verify the cube-map node is appended to the dword_8B8F14 list with count dword_8B6AC0 incremented and back-pointer at offset 0x12C set.
